messages.subject: RStan installation problem on Mac
parts:

rstan (Version 2.2.0, packaged: 2014-02-14 04:29:17 UTC, GitRev: 52d7b230aaa0)

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Re: RStan installation problem on Mac
parts:
It looks like it installed OK. Is there a problem using it
other than the pile of warning messages?

Did Rcpp install OK so that you could run the hello world demo
from it in the install instructions?

We're working on getting rid of all the warning messages --- they're
all harmless as far as functionality goes, but it'd be nicer to have
a clean install.

- Bob
